out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: The EHS provided copies of the vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures to the CFM for guidance and compliance.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: True 1 Dr ur cooler (47F)
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the refrigerator and provide proof of repairs to the EHS for review. The CFM relocated the food items to the top shelf of the Frigidaire cooler, and separated staff food items to the bottom shelf, until repairs can be made. Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.
